component.name: Timeline
component.summary: Plot what you read on a timeline

description.p: Timeline places the books and papers you read on a timeline, so you can see how works answer, borrow from and contradict each other across the centuries. Think of a linked notes graph, laid out in time instead.

ul.li: Every note has a date, from the Big Bang to this morning
Link notes with [[Title]] and see the links drawn between cards
Drag cards anywhere and they stay where you put them
Works offline, and syncs between devices through a private git repo you own

screenshot.caption: Books placed on a timeline from 1000 BCE to 2000 AD, with links between them
A note open in the side panel, written in Markdown
Deep time: geologic periods and mass extinctions marked
Settings: theme, accent colours, timeline markers, Vim mode and sync

description.p: Security hardening, signed and self-updating AppImage, and AppStream metadata.
